facts.fact: Communications minister Alioune Sall referred to the digital roadmap, the New Deal technologique, launched in February 2025 and tied to the national transformation agenda Senegal 2050.
Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko installed the 20-member Conseil national du numerique under the Primature's strategic coordination to support coordinated implementation of the New Deal technologique.

Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko installed the Conseil national du numerique, 20 members from the public and private sectors and civil society, to advise the state on digital policy; its working groups were announced and no opinion on a named law or policy is reported.
